text:
omar_sales: Quick sync — Cedar Health wants to sign this week. Legal returned MSA + DPA redlines that touch KMS/BYOK, SLA uptime, and a PO requirement. They also need SSO (SAML) metadata. Can ops/legal/finance confirm routing and impact?

omar_sales: Order form snippet they sent:
```
Plan: Dedicated-2 (reserved)
Term: 12 months
Billing: Net30, PO pending
Add-ons: 90-day logs retention, KMS BYOK option
SLA: 99.9% target, penalty language proposed
```

jamie_ps: +1 to getting this over the line. Two quick questions: does KMS BYOK force Private deployment (and extra lead time)? Also will accepting their SLA penalty language require exec signoff?

mike_ops: KMS BYOK = yes, requires Private deployment or our Dedicated with HSM integration. Expect ~2–3 weeks for key wrap + verification. We'll need a runbook and a vault access window. If they want BYOK on hosted, that's not supported.

beth_legal: Skimming their redlines — main asks: unlimited indemnity carveouts, data residency language, and a harsher SLA credit formula. We can accept most DPA items but cannot take broad indemnities or unlimited liability. Proposed path: counter with capped liability tied to fees, accept data residency for EU-only data if they commit to regions, and revise SLA credits to a reasonable cap (e.g., monthly credit up to 50% of fees for that service).

anna_finance: For PO/signature routing — procurement insists on a PO before first invoice. They prefer DocuSign + PO attachment. We can route envelope to finance@cedarhealth.com, with cc to omar_sales and anna_finance. If they need a paper signature we can do that but it'll add delay.

omar_sales: They indicated procurement requires "signed MSA + PO" before provisioning. Is a countersigned e-sign + PO PDF OK for Dedicated provisioning?

mike_ops: Yes — we can provision once we have a signed MSA (e-sign) and a valid PO PDF. For BYOK we'll need the key material exchange pre-provisioning window to be scheduled.

beth_legal: I'll prepare a limited countersign template. Main negotiation points we want to keep: 1) cap liability at 12 months of fees, 2) limited indemnity for IP claims only, 3) SLA credits capped, 4) standard DPA with subprocessors clause. If Cedar insists on anything more, escalate to execs.

jamie_ps: On pricing: the customer is asking for Dedicated unit pricing + the KMS add-on. If BYOK requires Private, there's a setup fee — recommend we add a one-time onboarding fee ($12k) and a 10% uplift on monthly reserved rate for the HSM ops overhead. I'll draft a pricing line.

anna_finance: Ack. Also need billing contact and PO number placeholder in the envelope. Omar — can you confirm the billing contact and whether they want invoices to a purchase order or supplier portal?

omar_sales: Billing contact is "procurement@cedarhealth.com" per their email. They said PO > supplier portal optional. I'll ask for PO# today and update.

deploy-bot: Reminder: contract templates updated 2026-01-04, use `MSA-v3.2-cs` as baseline for countersign.

beth_legal: Thanks @deploy-bot. Action items I have: prepare countersign with capped liability + revised SLA language, attach DPA standard appendix, and include an acceptance checkbox for BYOK (ops will add implementation notes). I'll aim to send by EOD PST.

mike_ops: Action: once countersign received, we'll schedule a BYOK planning call (30–60m) and provide a checklist:
```
- Key algorithm and format
- Key wrap instructions
- Test envelope for key transfer
- Access window and contact
```
I'll also estimate 2-week provisioning after key exchange.

anna_finance: I'll prep DocuSign envelope template with fields: signer (customer exec), PO attachment, billing contact, invoice email. Share link when ready.

jamie_ps: I'll update the quote with onboarding fee + BYOK uplift and attach to the envelope. Also will include a short SSO checklist:
```
- SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URL)
- Attributes required (email, name, groups)
- Test IdP contact
```

omar_sales: Perfect. I'll push Cedar for PO today and confirm SSO metadata + if they still require EU-only residency on certain datasets.

beth_legal: If procurement pushes for full indemnity or unlimited SLA penalties, escalate to me and I'll loop in the GC. Otherwise I think this counter will be acceptable.

anna_finance: Once PO arrives, route DocuSign to procurement@cedarhealth.com and finance@redwood.ai. cc: omar_sales.

omar_sales: Thanks team. I'll post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

(1 hour later)

omar_sales: Update — procurement sent provisional PO# CH-4592 (attached). They confirmed SSO metadata will come tomorrow. Proceeding with countersign draft.

beth_legal: Received PO# in thread. I'll include PO# in the countersign appendix and send the DocuSign envelope with countersign + DPA + order form. Target: send in ~2 hours.

mike_ops: Noted. Once envelope is out, we'll wait for signed MSA + PO PDF. Then ops will schedule BYOK call.

anna_finance: Ready to attach PO# and route. Let me know when the envelope link is live.

omar_sales: Thanks all — closing loop after DocuSign.
